title: Nilpotent constant-coefficient surjections reflect lissity
statement: Let D be a small category with pullbacks, T a Grothendieck topology, B a commutative Noetherian ring, R a commutative ring in the same universe, and f:B to R a surjection with nilpotent kernel. If K is a bounded-above standard-derived constant-B module complex and its derived scalar extension along f has locally constant finite-type cohomology over R, then K has locally constant finite-type cohomology over B. The scalar extension is adicFiniteExtension from [lem-sfb-adic-constructible-finite-reductions]; lissity is [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules].

proof.text: Compute both existing scalar-extension presentations on the same K-flat resolution and identify them by the explicit chain comparisons. Factor f through B/ker(f) and its canonical ring isomorphism to R.
Transport the lissity hypothesis through scalar associativity and the bijective coefficient map. Apply the nilpotent-ideal clause of reduction_pow to ker(f), choosing a positive nilpotence exponent.

theorem lisse_of_nilpotent_coefficient_surjection
    {D : Type w} [SmallCategory D] [HasPullbacks D] (T : GrothendieckTopology D)
    {B R : Type w} [CommRing B] [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (f : B →+* R) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hnil : IsNilpotent (RingHom.ker f))
    (K : ConstantCompletion.D (constant T B))
    (hbounded : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, b < q → IsZero ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj K))
    (hmod : ∀ q : ℤ, IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules T R
      ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.adicFiniteExtension T f).obj K))) :
    ∀ q : ℤ, IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules T B
      ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj K)
